sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by flow cytometry (anti-PA16 NZ-1 sorting) and membranous IHC staining (anti-PA16 NZ-33); no functional assay reported in the ledger.
sites.rationale: The paper (L1) reports a full-length, membrane-anchored CDH19 construct with an N-terminal PA16 tag from which the propeptide (residues 22–43) was deleted; the signal peptide (residues 1–21) is retained to direct trafficking. After SP cleavage the tag is the first extracellular element, placing the junction at residue 21/22 in canonical UniProt numbering. Python verification confirms residue 21 = G (last SP residue) and residue 22 = A (first mature residue), with 575 residues separating the tag from the TM boundary (597), far exceeding the ≥3-residue minimum. No residue number is named in the paper, so position_evidence is topology_derived. Full-length CDH19 construct (propeptide deleted) with N-terminal PA16 tag stably expressed in CHO cells; surface display confirmed by flow cytometry sorting with anti-PA16 mAb NZ-1 (L3) and by membranous IHC staining with anti-PA16 mAb NZ-33 (L4). The signal peptide ends at residue 21 (G) and the mature extracellular domain begins at residue 22 (A); the tag is placed after SP cleavage, so insert_after_residue=21 is the only valid N-terminal extracellular junction in canonical numbering.

sources.claim: The CDH19 cDNA without the pro-peptide was subcloned into the pCAG-Ble vector with an N-terminal PA16 tag [ 22 ].
Additionally, the CDH19 cDNA with an N-terminal MAP16 tag [ 23 ] was constructed.

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) concern the same N-terminal extracellular junction of CDH19 (insert_after_residue=21). L1 and L2 describe two independent tagged constructs (PA16 and MAP16 respectively) at that junction; L3 confirms surface display of both by flow cytometry; L4 provides additional IHC confirmation for the PA16 construct. No internal loop insertions, C-terminal extracellular tags, or intracellular tags are reported in the ledger. The propeptide (residues 22–43, ending at the furin-like RVKR motif at positions 40–43) is deleted in both constructs; the tag is placed between the cleaved signal peptide and the mature ectodomain. No functional assays (adhesion, signalling) are reported in any ledger clip, so validation_level is surface_only for both sites. No other positions qualify.
